notes: The paper's own model-vintage label is self-contradictory: "GPT-4-Turbo (March 2023)" predates any real Turbo release (Nov 2023 preview / Apr 2024 GA), and the other three models in the same sentence carry equally wrong dates (Llama 3 70B "May 2023", Qwen 72B "April 2023"), so the actual snapshot behind the reported numbers cannot be identified despite a fully quoted prompt and a clean metric.
